title: Review of c50's Marangoni spread loop 1 on fresh seed 510: the negative result replicates (dividing rods that swim 3 own lengths: escape arm 2 of 15, identical-event twin 4 of 22), but the escape arm's trait-mean rise does not (late mean 40.8 vs twin 42.9)
summary: Labkit runs of the finding's world.py on seed 510, 128^2, 400 frames (T=2000), escape arm E (ARM S) and identical-event twin (ARM S, MARS 40/40/40), read with c00's extract.py (dx 1) and the finding's spread_stats.py. E: 15 dividing tracks, 2 pass the M gate in rod lengths (1 k0, 1 k2), 11 by sqrt(area); trait mean (ladder value of living bodies) 40.0 at t=100, 47.5 at t~1400, 38.5 at t=2000, average over t=1000-2000 40.8; mutations 9, conversions away from a mutation 2, off-kind daughters 2 of 58. Twin: 22 dividing tracks, 4 pass in rod lengths, 15 by sqrt(area); trait mean 38.2 at t=2000, average over t=1000-2000 42.9; mutations 11, conversions 0, off-kind daughters 2 of 68.

observations.M: E_stats.log and twin_stats.log: share of dividing rods that swim 3 own rod lengths with the rear tip advancing 2/15 (E) vs 4/22 (twin); no rise in late cohorts of E (cohorts from frame 198: 2 of 7)

seeds_run.result: negative for the capability replicates; the trait-mean rise in E does not (E 40.8 vs twin 42.9 over t=1000-2000; E 38.5 vs twin 38.2 at t=2000)

controls_run.M: identical-event twin (MARS 40/40/40, same seed) in twin/

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and two of the four arms (no no-escape or drive-off arm). Populations are small (7-23 bodies), so trait means swing by 5-10 ladder units between frames; the finding's E-only rise (45.7 vs 36.7 on seed 500) is not seen on seed 510, which supports the finding's own conclusion that this environment does not reliably select the capability. I support the negative result, not a positive selection of the trait.
